newsitem.title: UK: List of British non-cabinet minister appointments.
newsitem.headline: List of British non-cabinet minister appointments.

text.p: Prime Minister Tony Blair's office has announced the following non-cabinet ministerial appointments following the Labour Party's May 1 election victory:
-- Department for the Environment and Transport
Ministers of State: Hilary Armstrong MP, Dick Caborn MP
Parliamentary Under-Secretaries of State: Nick Raynsford MP, Glenda Jackson MP, Baroness Hayman, Angela Eagle MP
-- Treasury
Paymaster General Geoffrey Robinson MP, Financial Secretary Dawn Primarolo MP, Economic Secretary Helen Liddell MP
-- Foreign and Commonwealth Office
Ministers of State: Derek Fatchett MP, Doug Henderson MP, Tony Lloyd MP
Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State: Baroness Symons of Vernham Dean
-- Lord Chancellor's Department
Parliamentary Secretary: Geoff Hoon MP
-- Home Office
Ministers of State: Alun Michael MP, Joyce Quin MP
Parliamentary Under-Secretaries of State: George Howarth MP, Mike O'Brien MP, Lord Williams of Mostyn
-- Education and Employment:
Ministers of State: Stephen Byers MP, Baroness Blackstone
Parliamentary Under-Secretaries of State: Estelle Morris MP, Kim Howells MP, Alan Howarth MP
-- Department of Trade and Industry
Ministers of State: Lord Clinton-Davis, Ian McCartney MP, John Battle MP
Parliamentary Under-Secretaries of State: Nigel Griffiths MP, Barbara Roche MP
-- Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food
Minister of State: Jeff Rooker MP
Parliamentary Secretaries: Elliot Morley MP, Lord Donoughue
-- Scottish Office
Ministers of State: Henry McLeish MP, Brian Wilson MP
Parliamentary Under-Secretaries of State: Lord Sewel, Sam Galbraith MP, Malcolm Chisholm MP
-- Ministry of Defence
Ministers of State: John Gilbert, John Reid MP
Parliamentary Under Secretaries of State: John Spellar MP
-- Department of Health
Ministers of State: Alan Milburn MP, Tessa Jowell MP, Baroness Jay of Paddington
Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State: Paul Boateng MP
-- Department of National Heritage
Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State: Tony Banks MP
-- Department of Social Security
Minister of State: Frank Field MP
Parliamentary Under-Secretaries of State:
Keith Bradley MP, Baroness Hollis of Heigham, John Denham MP -- Northern Ireland Office
Ministers of State: Adam Ingram MP, Paul Murphy MP
Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State: Tony Worthington MP
-- Welsh Office
Parliamentary Under-Secretaries of State: Peter Hain MP, Win Griffiths MP
-- Department for International Development
Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State: George Foulkes MP
-- Cabinet Office
Minister without Portfolio: Peter Mandelson MP
-- Office of Public Service
Parliamentary Secretary: Peter Kilfoyle MP
-- Law Officers' Department
Attorney General: John Morris MP
Solicitor General: Charles Falconer.
Life baronys were conferred upon: Charles Falconer on his appointment as Solicitor General and John Gilbert on his appointment as a Defence Minister of State.
Further appointments will be announced in due course.
